testcase.name: the stance table is still-hip, still-ADS, moving-hip, moving-ADS
a three round burst is centred on the aim at 0.55 degree spacing
movement is a speed threshold, not a key press
pellet jitter is smaller while aiming
burst jitter is a fifth of the live spread, both signs
deviation stays inside the cone and clusters near its centre
eight pellets spread evenly across the whole cone, endpoints included
spraying and tapping diverge over about a second, not instantly
shot kick is scaled by the recoil multiplier and stops at the ceiling
recovery is linear in degrees per second and 1.5x faster while aiming
